fullPassage: All carbohydrates are basically sugars. Complex carbohydrates are the good carbohydrates for your body. These complex sugar compounds are very difficult to break down and can trap other nutrients like vitamins and minerals in their chains. As they slowly break down, the other nutrients are also released into your body, and can provide you with fuel for a number of hours. Bad carbohydrates, on the other hand, are simple sugars. Because their structure is not complex, they are easy to break down and hold few nutrients for your body other than the sugars from which they are made. Your body breaks down these carbohydrates rather quickly and what it cannot use is converted to fat and stored in the body.

det.tip: be + p.p.(수동태): is converted to fat

questions.passage: All carbohydrates are basically sugars. Complex carbohydrates are the good carbohydrates for your body. These complex sugar compounds are very difficult to break down and can trap other nutrients like vitamins and minerals in their chains. As they slowly break down, the other nutrients are also released into your body, and can provide you with fuel for a number of hours. Bad carbohydrates, on the other hand, are simple sugars. Because their structure is not complex, they are easy to break down and hold few nutrients for your body other than the sugars from which they are made. Your body breaks down these carbohydrates rather quickly and what it cannot use is converted to fat and stored in the body.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 본문은 복합 탄수화물과 단순(나쁜) 탄수화물의 차이와 몸에서의 작용을 설명
det.analysis:
❌ ① 비타민·무기질 섭취법: 세부 예시일 뿐
❌ ② 지방 저장 과정: 세부 내용일 뿐
✅ ③ 복합·단순 탄수화물의 차이와 작용: 두 종류의 분해 속도·영양소·결말을 대비하는 글 전체 논지 ←정답
❌ ④ 조리법: 본문과 무관

det.tip: complex: slow + fuel / bad(simple): quick + stored as fat
